messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — opened a docs PR for Dedicated capacity onboarding. Added a short 'batching & quantization' examples section and a Python SDK snippet. Need a quick sanity check on wording and the snippet.

Jamie Rogers: link?

Alex Chen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — sorry for the large diff, focused on a small new subsection under /dedicated/serving.

Priya Nanda: Skimming now. Do we have perf numbers for int8 vs fp16 to back the recommendation about quantization?

Alex Chen: Not formal numbers yet — I left a caution: "quantization may affect generation quality; run evals on your prompts." Happy to add microbench results if someone can run them.

Samir Patel: I can run a quick perfbench on a small tenant workload and post numbers by EOD.

Jamie Rogers: Quick note — the PR links to /dedicated/autoscale but we renamed that page to /dedicated/autoscaling last quarter. That link will 404 in prod. Can you update the internal link to the canonical path?

Alex Chen: Good catch — just updated the link to /docs/dedicated/autoscaling and added a redirect note for older URLs.

Ellie (docs-bot): lint check: codeblock indentation error in the Python SDK example (line 12). See https://ci.docs.redwood.ai/482/checks.

Alex Chen: Whoops, fixing now. Replacing the snippet with a properly formatted one.

Alex Chen: ```python
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.dedicated.generate(
    model='redwood/dedicated-medium',
    prompt='Summarize the following...',
    batching={'max_batch_size': 8, 'batch_timeout_ms': 25},
)
print(resp.text)
```

Priya Nanda: Small wording nit: in the "isolation" paragraph you say "tenant-level isolation prevents noisy neighbors" — can we add a short example describing eviction vs reserved capacity and how that impacts SLAs?

Alex Chen: Good call — I added a bullet list showing three scenarios: reserved capacity, preemptible burst, and eviction behavior with sample SLA outcomes. Kept it concise rather than a full table.

Samir Patel: Perfbench results (rb-2026-03-21-07): FP16 median p95 token latency 45ms, INT8 median p95 38ms; quality delta (internal eval) ~0.8% lower for INT8 on our representative prompts. Numbers vary by model & sequence length.

Jamie Rogers: Can we include those numbers as an example with a clear "your mileage may vary" caveat? That would help teams make a quick tradeoff call.

Alex Chen: Yep — added the sample numbers and cited the run_id. Also added a short note: "Run evals on production prompts before enabling quantization for SLAs."

Jamie Rogers: LGTM after lint pass and CI. @Ellie (docs-bot) any followups?

Ellie (docs-bot): Suggestion: replace internal repo link with canonical /docs/dedicated/autoscaling and add a redirect rule in the redirects table (docs/redirects.yaml). Filed a tiny follow-up PR suggestion.

deploy-bot: Deploy preview available — https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/482 (expires in 24h)

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — merging once CI passes. I'll open a separate short migration note for tenants still using the old autoscale URL and ping eng-oncall if any customers hit the redirect. :thumbsup:
